key_insight: CRC-HGD is a curated histopathology image dataset designed to support automated grading of colorectal cancer across three WHO differentiation grades and multiple magnifications.
clinical_relevance: A standardized, labeled dataset like CRC-HGD can help advance AI tools that may improve consistency and efficiency in colorectal cancer grading research.
evidence_signal: The dataset includes labeled images from Grade I, II, and III tumors, with the abstract emphasizing availability and structured grading rather than model performance results.
watch_item: Class imbalance across grades and single-center sourcing may limit generalizability, so external validation is important before broader use.
paper_title: CRC-HGD: A Histopathological Image Dataset for Grading Colorectal Cancer
